jobs.name: Omega — Afterlife
jobs.referenceLimit: Capture de la salle principale redistribuée par un article; cadrage source 3:2, reformatage horizontal du premier plan nécessaire.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one wide 16:9 high-definition 2D fighting-game stage background. Recreate the identifiable MAIN ROOM OF AFTERLIFE ON OMEGA AS SEEN IN MASS EFFECT 2 from the attached gameplay reference. The reference image is the architecture, materials, palette, and camera authority. Preserve the huge cylindrical magenta hologram column in the center, its closely spaced luminous horizontal rings and pale abstract curves, the dark circular elevated ring-stage crossing in front of it, slim vertical suspension cables, the two banks of small warm circular lights behind, the curved dark-metal guardrail, curved lounge edges, deep burgundy industrial walls, and the red illuminated floor panels flanking the darker central metal strip. Keep the corresponding horizontal alignments and the two-level sense of depth. Scene only, temporarily empty of patrons, dancers and holographic human silhouettes; retain the magenta column as an abstract light pattern. Reframe the existing foreground floor as a continuous, unobstructed horizontal fighting lane in the lower quarter while preserving the reference's location and dark metal/red tile design. Camera at adult standing eye level, nearly level frontal view, clear midground rail behind the lane; gently extend only the outer edges to a widescreen frame. Polished realistic game environment rendering with material detail, not pixel art or cartoon. Preserve the original red/magenta club lighting without making the foreground unreadably black. One opaque environment image, no fighters, no HUD, no labels, no new architecture, no added arena markings, no split panels, no text or logo.

jobs.name: Académie Grissom — atrium
jobs.referenceLimit: Vue du décor publiée par Graham Kelly; la scène centrale est exploitable mais la bande de combat plus large requiert un recadrage du premier plan.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one wide 16:9 high-definition 2D fighting-game stage background. Recreate the GRISSOM ACADEMY ATRIUM from MASS EFFECT 3 using the attached environment screenshot as the exact architecture, materials and color authority. Preserve its large circular white-and-gray two-story courtyard, huge open/glazed skylight with curved luminous rings and broad diagonal white structural ribs, the cloudy blue overhead light, the green planted central court, its several tall slender trees, the cylindrical gray planters with pale blue vertical motifs, the curving white balustrades and right-side ramp with dark textured flooring, the middle diagonal ramp, the left rock wall, the background doors and bench row. Keep the visible asymmetry and those identifiable placements rather than making a generic symmetrical station interior. Reframe the front section of the same dark gray curved walkway into a readable, uninterrupted horizontal combat lane across the lower quarter; keep planters, benches and scorched objects behind the lane. Remove characters, enemies, interface and weapons; preserve the location's subdued signs of damage as static scenery. A finely rendered realistic HD game background matching the reference's cool diffuse daylight and cyan trim, not cartoon or pixel art. One complete opaque wide image. No extra towers, no added arena rails or platforms, no promotional border, no title, no labels, no text, no logo, no split panels.

jobs.name: Hagalaz — coque du Courtier
jobs.referenceLimit: Deux captures réelles de la coque et de ses capaciteurs; la bande de duel est un recadrage de la structure existante, sans preuve de topologie jouable ni couches météo séparées.
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one wide 16:9 high-definition 2D fighting-game stage background. Recreate the EXTERIOR HULL OF THE SHADOW BROKER'S SHIP ABOVE HAGALAZ in MASS EFFECT 2: LAIR OF THE SHADOW BROKER. Image 1 is the composition and architectural reference: preserve the immense faceted dark gray vessel superstructure projecting overhead from the upper left, small cyan indicator lights along its heavy panel seams, the gold-brown turbulent sunset clouds behind it, the lower row of angled hull ridges, and the distinctive tall slanted LIGHTNING CAPACITOR at the right with its two slender black rods and cold blue-white electrical channels embedded inside the housing. Image 2 is only a supporting reference for the capacitor's exact angular housing, dark ribbed hull plates, recessed panel texture and heavy surface cables; do not use its combat action or interface. Match these identifiable forms and materials closely, rather than inventing a generic spaceship deck. Use the same location from a slightly lowered, leveled wide camera so a continuous horizontal strip of the existing black metallic hull deck spans the bottom quarter as the fighting lane, with the large capacitor behind the right end of that lane and the looming superstructure occupying the upper-left background. Keep the sharp ship geometry, strong scale contrast and sepia storm palette. Improve local readability of the lower deck just enough to separate it from the sky, without flattening the atmosphere. Scene is empty: remove all people, weapons, combat beams, HUD and labels. Preserve soft electrical light inside the fixed capacitor; no lightning bolt, heavy rain streak or smoke plume across the foreground lane. No new guardrails, crates, arena markings, buildings or planets. One complete opaque finely rendered HD game environment, realistic materials, not pixel art or cartoon. No text, logo, caption, border, split panel or inset.
